lede: Thanksgiving week lands squarely in the middle of this stretch, and the Turkey Trot on Thursday morning is the kind of thing that gets half the valley out of bed early before the feast — with An Outlaw Thanksgiving at Alloy Kitchen and live music at Mountain Lodge rounding out the holiday. On the government side, four meetings are on the calendar this week, but none have posted agendas yet, so there's nothing consequential to track right now. The library and KOTO have the quieter days covered with drop-in tech help, a pumpkin beer tasting, and dance fitness if you need to move before the long weekend hits.
